user_story: As a staff member, I want confirming an already-cancelled booking to return an error so that invalid state transitions are blocked.

positive.title: Confirm a valid booking
steps: Given I have a booking that is active
Then I should see a success message indicating the booking is confirmed

negative.title: Attempt to confirm an already-cancelled booking
steps: Given I have a booking that has been cancelled
When I attempt to confirm the booking
Then I should see an error message indicating that the booking cannot be confirmed because it is already cancelled
negative.expected_result: Error message is displayed: 'Cannot confirm as the booking is already cancelled.'

edge.title: Confirm a booking that was cancelled recently
steps: Given I have a booking that was cancelled 1 minute ago
When I attempt to confirm the booking
Then I should see an error message indicating that the booking cannot be confirmed because it is already cancelled
edge.expected_result: Error message is displayed: 'Cannot confirm as the booking is already cancelled.'
